---
name: Add new comp to CompWorkflow
about: Whenever you plan a new competition, generate list of tasks and a configuration
  file.
title: "[NEW COMP]"
labels: comp
assignees: ''

---

### <Put the name of the comp here>

---

> Preparation

---

#### Contact...
- [ ] ... venue
- [ ] ... potential organizers
- [ ] ... potential delegates

#### Initial budgeting and bookkeeping
- [ ] Generate a budget sheet (e.g. copy of previous edition)
- [ ] Create entry in "German WCA Competitions" spreadsheet (tbf)

#### Refine budgeting and bookkeeping
- [ ] Add estimated costs
- [ ] Add estimated income
- [ ] Define registration fee
- [ ] Define a person handling payments
- [ ] Sign contract ("Vertrag") with venue
- [ ] Sign contract ("Vertrag") for insurance
- [ ] Receive insurance policy ("Versicherungsschein") or preliminary policy ("Deckungsbestätigung")
- [ ] (Sometimes required) ask for permission (local authorities)
- [ ] Modify entry in "German WCA Competitions" spreadsheet (fixed)
- [ ] Contact shop or other companies for sponsorship

#### Standard tasks for CompWorkflow to get started
- [ ] Prepare a mailing list or group (as contact option for competitors)
- [ ] Fill out the config file

#### WCA website
- [ ] Create (e.g. from previous edition)
- [ ] Fill out standard items
- [ ] Define events
- [ ] Create schedule
- [ ] (If big comp) Generate a signup_register_pay_help.png file from the .key template
- [ ] (Optional) Generate a logo / further assets in high resolution and slightly reduced res
- [ ] Run `generateWebsiteTabs`
- [ ] Fill out main page and tabs

#### Media & Communication
- [ ] Prepare channels of communication
- [ ] Prepare social media (e.g. Insta, FB)

---

> Announced

---

#### More bookkeeping
- [ ] (Sometimes required) send insurance certificate to local authorities / venue provider (show proof of insurance)
- [ ] Modify entry in "German WCA Competitions" spreadsheet (announced)

#### (Optional) Unofficial events
- [ ] Contact Cubing Contests (Deni) for moderator rights
- [ ] Add comp to Cubing Contests

#### More sponsorship, media
- [ ] Contact shop or other companies for sponsorship
- [ ] Remind shop or other companies for sponsorship
- [ ] Contact T-Shirts / Merchandise shop
- [ ] Prepare merchandise conditions or prepare form for order
- [ ] Send logo to merchandise company
- [ ] Use social media channels for news / updates

#### Registration management
- [ ] Familiarize with reg system
- [ ] Track registrations, payments
- [ ] Set up waiting list
- [ ] Handle refunds

#### For comp itself
- [ ] Modify schedule
- [ ] Create groups / assignments
- [ ] Distribute who brings material
- [ ] Print or Digital? scramble preparation
- [ ] (If FMC:) FMC sheets
- [ ] Design certificates
- [ ] Design medals
- [ ] Order medals / other awards
- [ ] (Pre-)Print certificates

---

> Done

---

#### Admin stuff
- [ ] Double-check last stuff
- [ ] Get all scramble files
- [ ] Verify newcomer data
- [ ] Upload results
- [ ] Write report
- [ ] Finalize budget with all outstanding items
- [ ] Create survey
- [ ] Send aftercomp mail
